newsitem.title: UK: LVMH move seen delaying Guinness merger.
newsitem.headline: LVMH move seen delaying Guinness merger.

text.p: A proposed 24 billion pound merger between Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc and drinks group Guinness Plc is likely to be held up by the "spoiling tactics" of French drinks and luxury goods company LVMH, analysts said on Wednesday.

LVMH, which holds an estimated 14.2 percent stake in Guinness, said earlier it would exercise its option to buy Guinness out of all their joint venture companies if the latter went ahead with its merger with GrandMet.
LVMH said it believed the merger would create a "control event" that would allow it to exercise its option to buy Guinness' interests in their joint ventures at net asset value.

"I think it will delay and disrupt the deal with lengthy legal proceedings in prospect and the chances of it going ahead in its current form are now much reduced," said Charles Winston, analyst at HSBC James Capel.
